meta.scope: 17 selected intercity and international city pairs. Metro, tram, S-Bahn/S-train and local urban networks are excluded. Short mainline intercity links are included in these compact countries. Not every route, train or operator.
meta.timing_note: Indicative times from linked operator, official destination or explicitly identified independent timetable sources. Figures may be fastest, average or illustrative. Check the individual service basis and travel date; a change may be required. Reverse directions are grouped together.
meta.distance_note: Most distances are rounded atlas planning estimates, explicitly labelled. They are not operator-published or certified track mileage and must not be used to calculate live kilometres remaining. Published reference distances are identified separately.
meta.license_note: Selected facts with links; Natural Earth country-qualified city locations and outlines, supplemented with rounded geographic connection points.
